What powers it

Built on what the studio already runs on.

Deepgram Nova-3

Live speech, tuned for Indian English. Raw audio, proxied server-side.

Claude

Structured extraction — amounts, rates, quantities, spoken corrections.

Google Drive

Read-only on the client sheet. Fuzzy matching, low-confidence review.

Gmail API

Sent from the studio mailbox. The attachment never passes through AI.

React · Tailwind

One screen, one button, with Framer Motion and Radix.

FastAPI · Python

Extraction, rendering and sending, all server side.

PostgreSQL

Frozen proposal inputs, send history and the audit record.

Render · Docker

Deploys on push. A five-page render smoke test runs on every build.

The studio's existing Python renderer and HTML template are used byte-for-byte unchanged.

07

07

Why not just Claude?

Claude writes it. Something else had to send it.

A chat window is built for conversation, not for producing a correct file and putting it on an email in one unbroken step. Two routes were tried before this one.

The thinking was never the problem. The plumbing was.

First tryChat, exporting through Google DocsFive to ten minutes per proposal, and attachments that arrived empty or with the wrong contents. Too slow to use in front of a client, too unreliable to trust.
Second tryZapier webhooksThe request never carried a proper data payload, so the automation had nothing to act on. Failures were silent, which is worse than failing loudly.
NowA purpose-built applicationIts own rendering engine, running the studio's existing template. Seconds instead of minutes, and the same output every single time.

Claude still does the thinking — through the API rather than a chat window. It hears the brief, pulls out the figures and writes the proposal. Generating the file and sending the mail is handled by code built for exactly that job, and nothing else.
